TokenMeter v0.2.3 refreshes Codex subscription quotas independently of conversation logs.

## Changes

- Read the official `codex` quota bucket every minute through the installed Codex app-server, including during long-running tasks.
- Reuse Codex's existing sign-in without login dialogs, browser prompts, or credential-file access.
- Keep 5-hour and 7-day windows separate and never substitute Spark/auxiliary buckets for the main quota.
- Retain the last successful quota during transient failures, with local logs as an initial fallback.
- Do not fabricate a 100% allowance when a cached reset time passes without a fresh server response.
- Show usage only for signed-out, API-key-only, and free accounts; clear cached subscription quotas when that state is detected.
- Refresh after waking from sleep and when opening the menu, with requests debounced in the background.

The menu layout and historical usage/pricing calculations are unchanged. Usage records remain local. Only the official Codex client contacts its account service for quota information; TokenMeter does not log or persist credentials or account identifiers.

Requires macOS 13 or later. The universal archive supports Apple Silicon and Intel. Codex quota refresh requires an installed Codex/ChatGPT desktop app or Codex CLI with an existing subscription login; usage tracking works without either.
